topics.name: Indian history
topics.description: Archives and scholarship on the history of India and South Asia.

topics.name: Science and logic
topics.description: Research literature, scientific bodies and reference works on logic.

sources.label: Encyclopaedia Britannica
sources.notes: Edited reference work; good for dates, names and established narratives.

sources.label: Internet Archive
sources.notes: Digitised books, gazetteers and periodicals. Check the uploader and edition.

sources.label: Avalon Project (Yale Law School)
sources.notes: Treaties, charters and diplomatic documents in full text.

sources.label: Library of Congress
sources.notes: Manuscripts, maps, newspapers and research guides.

sources.label: The National Archives (UK)
sources.notes: Colonial Office and India Office material, with teaching guides.

sources.label: Abhilekh Patal (National Archives of India)
sources.notes: Catalogue and digitised records of the National Archives of India.

sources.label: Indian Culture Portal
sources.notes: Government of India portal for rare books, manuscripts and gazetteers.

sources.label: JSTOR
sources.notes: Peer-reviewed journals. Many full texts are paywalled, so results may rely on abstracts.

sources.label: Wikipedia (English)
sources.notes: Useful for leads, not as final evidence. Switched off by default.

sources.label: PubMed
sources.notes: Abstracts of biomedical and life-science research. Check the study type before relying on a result.

sources.label: Cochrane Library
sources.notes: Systematic reviews of health interventions: among the strongest kinds of evidence.

sources.label: Nature journals
sources.notes: Peer-reviewed research across the sciences. Some articles are paywalled.

sources.label: Science (AAAS)
sources.notes: Peer-reviewed research and news from the AAAS. Some articles are paywalled.

sources.label: NASA
sources.notes: Space, Earth and climate science data and explainers.

sources.label: World Health Organization
sources.notes: Health guidelines, fact sheets and statistics.

sources.label: NIST
sources.notes: Physical constants, units and measurement standards.

sources.label: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
sources.notes: Peer-reviewed entries on logic, reasoning and philosophy of science.
